title: AAPS 3.4.0.0. crash after importing 3.3.1.3 settings due to Tidepool integration
body:
Config:
- Phone is Xiaomi 15 on Android 16 (HyperOS 3.0.7.0)
- Using AAPS 3.3.1.3 fullrelease (built dec 2025.01.30) with Medtrum Nano patch and Xdrip glucose and Tidepool upload

Steps taken
- Build AAPS 3.4.0.0 using Android Studio with **new** signature keys (since laptop was lost and I didn't backup keys offsite)
- Export settings of AAP 3.3.1.3.
- Uninstall 3.3.1.3 and install AAPS 3.4.0.0. (due to new keys updating the app doesnt work)
- Walk through setup steps in AAPS and grant all permissions, set AAPS folder the same as previous app. Note that I did not remove the AAPS folder.
- Restore settings, then AAPS requests to close to apply settings.
- After closure AAPS crashes after 1-2s after reopening

Possible cause:
AAPS seems to crash due to the Tidepool integration. Are there incompatibilities?

Work-around
Disable the Tidepool synchronisation on previous AAPS version (3.3.1.3) and export the settings. Importing these settings into AAPS 3.4.0.0. works without crash.

[AndroidAPS.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25457949/AndroidAPS.log)
